latest.notes: Updates can now be installed from Settings → System: signed index, pre-update snapshot, git/pip update as the repo owner, automatic rollback when the service does not come back healthy. Also adds the update status endpoint and helper contract tests.

releases.notes: Updates can now be installed from Settings → System: signed index, pre-update snapshot, git/pip update as the repo owner, automatic rollback when the service does not come back healthy. Also adds the update status endpoint and helper contract tests.

Update check: Settings → System now shows the running version and whether a newer release is published (signed index). Products renamed: Files, Packages, Videos, Cameras, Downloads, Photos. Public repository, MIT license.
